title: 绒球小鸡
style: fluffy pompom mascot, fine yellow fibers, black felt features, pastel blue stage
beats: One tiny yellow pompom separates from the top tuft
It lands beside the head as a baby puff
A little orange fiber beak appears on the puff
The puff hops toward the parent face
It springs back onto the top
The tuft merges into its original pompom shape
